segments.text: The data file holds base64 encoded text, and decoding it gives the password for bandit eleven.
I log in as bandit10 with ssh bandit10@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
Base64 is a reversible encoding into a safe ASCII alphabet, not encryption, so I run base64 minus d on data dot txt.
The decoded output reads, the password is, followed by the password for bandit eleven, and the level is solved.
